text:
marta: FYI we're targeting tonight's publish window (19:00-21:00 PT) for Py 1.5.0 and TS 2.0.0. Small canary then gradual.
leo: Can you drop the exact publish commands and dist-tag plan?
marta: Py: pip upload wheel sdist -> pypi 1.5.0; TS: npm publish @redwood/sdk@2.0.0 then `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@2.0.0 next`. Canary plan: start at 5%.
anya: Note: TS is async-only change; we're deprecating the sync client on Py with warnings for two releases. Need text in release notes.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary job queued (1735551111-canary): python:1.5.0@5%, ts:2.0.0@5%, ETA +5m.
anya: Quick staging smoke failed for TS. Error: `TypeError: client.request is not a function` — looks like polyfill/shim issue. Repro in PR.
leo: Hold TS canary. deploy-bot, rollback canary 1735551111-canary-ts and revert dist-tag to 1.9.4
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback started for 1735551111-canary-ts. Removing 2.0.0 from 'next' and restoring 1.9.4.
ops: For Python path, pin fallback: redwood@1.4.12 pinned to fallback pool on Dedicated. TTL 24h. Command: curl -X POST https://internal.ops/api/pins -d '{"package":"redwood","version":"1.4.12","pool":"fallback"}'
bek: I'll write release notes; will call out TS delay and deprecation timeline for `redwood-sync`. Draft PR link when ready.
marta: Rollback triggers: error rate >2% on tokenized requests, production smoke failures, checksum mismatch, auth regressions >1%. Ops please ensure alerts wired.
ops: Alerts set (2% error; +30ms p50). Playbook for quick unpin and dist-tag reassignment uploaded.
leo: Proceeding with Py canary at 5% now. Monitor 30m then 25% if green. If any trigger fires we follow rollback playbook and notify #eng-oncall and #devex.
